69504-the-northern-whale-fishery.description: A book by Captain Scoresby, F.R.S.E.. prey began to multiply and annoy the vocations of man, the personal dangers to which he must have been occasionally exposed would oblige him to contrive some means of defence. For this end, he would naturally be induced, both to prepare weapons, and also to preconceive plans for resisting the disturbers of his peace.

arxiv-1901-01288.title: Search for the pair production of light top squarks in the \Pe ± ​ \Pgm ∓ \Pe^{\pm}\Pgm^{\mp} final state in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 \TeV
arxiv-1901-01288.description: Abstract A search for the production of a pair of top squarks at the LHC is presented. This search targets a region of parameter space where the kinematics of top squark pair production and top quark pair production are very similar, because of the mass difference between the top squark and the neutralino being close to the top quark mass.

arxiv-2006-03285.title: On the Scaling Properties of Magnetic Field Fluctuations Through the Inner Heliosphere Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2006-03285.creator: Tommaso Alberti, Monica Laurenza, Giuseppe Consolini, Anna Milillo, Maria Federica Marcucci, Vincenzo Carbone, Stuart D. Bale
arxiv-2006-03285.description: Abstract Although the interplanetary magnetic field variability has been extensively investigated in situ by means of data coming from several space missions, the newly launched missions providing high-resolution measures and approaching the Sun, offer the possibility to study the multiscale variability in the innermost solar system.

arxiv-2110-13073.title: Stabilization of phase noise in spin torque nano oscillators by a phase locked loop
arxiv-2110-13073.creator: Steffen Wittrock, Martin Kreißig, Bertrand Lacoste, Artem Litvinenko, Philippe Talatchian, Florian Protze, Frank Ellinger, Ricardo Ferreira, Romain Lebrun, Paolo Bortolotti, Liliana Buda-Prejbeanu, Ursula Ebels, Vincent Cros
arxiv-2110-13073.description: Abstract The main limitation in order to exploit spin torque nano-oscillators (STNOs) in various potential applications is their large phase noise. In this work, we demonstrate its efficient reduction by a highly reconfigurable, compact, specifically on-chip designed PLL based on custom integrated circuits. First, we thoroughly study the parameter space of the PLL+STNO system experimentally.

arxiv-2207-06397.title: Quantum state tomography with tensor train cross approximation
arxiv-2207-06397.creator: Alexander Lidiak, Casey Jameson, Zhen Qin, Gongguo Tang, Michael B. Wakin, Zhihui Zhu, Zhexuan Gong
arxiv-2207-06397.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexander Lidiak, Casey Jameson, Zhen Qin, Gongguo Tang, Michael B. Wakin, Zhihui Zhu, Zhexuan Gong. It has been recently shown that a state generated by a one-dimensional noisy quantum computer is well approximated by a matrix product operator with a finite bond dimension independent of the number of qubits. We show that full quantum state tomography can be performed for such a state with a minimal number of measurement settings using a method known as tensor train cross approximation.

arxiv-2310-07526.title: Interaction-aware Traffic Prediction and Scenario-based Model Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicles on Highways*
arxiv-2310-07526.creator: Xiaorong Zhang, Sahar Zeinali, Georg Schildbach
arxiv-2310-07526.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of traffic prediction and control of autonomous vehicles on highways. A modified Interacting Multiple Model Kalman filter algorithm is applied to predict the motion behavior of the traffic participants by considering their interactions. A scenario generation component is used to produce plausible scenarios of the vehicles based on the predicted information.

arxiv-2405-07831.title: Prospects for detection of the pair-echo emission from TeV gamma-ray bursts
arxiv-2405-07831.creator: D.Miceli, P. Da Vela, E. Prandini
arxiv-2405-07831.description: Abstract The intergalactic magnetic field (IGMF) present in the voids of large-scale structures is considered to be the weakest magnetic field in the Universe. Gamma-ray observations of blazars in the GeV-TeV domain have led to lower limits on the IGMF strength based on the search for delayed or extended emission.

arxiv-2506-03204.title: On the first-order theory of the remainder
arxiv-2506-03204.creator: Mihai Prunescu
arxiv-2506-03204.description: Abstract It is proved that the first-order theory of the structure ( ℕ , mod ) (\mathbb{N},\bmod) is undecidable. Here mod \bmod denotes the operation of computing the remainder for any division between positive integers; i.e, x mod y x\bmod y is the remainder obtained by the division x : y x:y .

arxiv-2509-25838.title: Bulk viscosity from neutron decays to dark baryons in neutron star matter
arxiv-2509-25838.creator: Steven P. Harris, C.J. Horowitz
arxiv-2509-25838.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Steven P. Harris, C.J. Horowitz. The possibility of neutron decay into dark particles has been proposed as a way to resolve a growing discrepancy between two different measurements of the neutron lifetime. The most popular formulation is a dark sector consisting of a dark baryon χ \chi and a dark scalar ϕ \phi , where a neutron in vacuum decays about 1% of the time via the channel n → χ + ϕ n\rightarrow\chi+\phi .

arxiv-2602-01182.creator: Zhichao Chen, Hao Wang, Fangyikang Wang, Licheng Pan, Zhengnan Li, Yunfei Teng, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin

pmc-10553915.title: SAT212 Collateral Damage A Case Of Refractory Hyperparathyroidism In A Young Woman With End Stage Renal Disease
pmc-10553915.creator: Ed Wong Alvarado, Valentine Sampson Alia, Henry Reinhart, Rachel Giese
pmc-10553915.description: Disclosure: E.W. Alvarado: None. V. Alia: None. H. Reinhart: None. R. Giese: None. Background: The Rio Grande Valley (RGV) is a community with the highest incidence of ESRD in the USA. Hyperparathyroidism (HPT), defined as a serum PTH >65 pg/mL, HPT is a secondary complication of ESRD affecting 80% of individuals in this population.

pmc-10585563.title: Simultaneous percutaneous microwave ablation and biopsy for highly suspected malignant pulmonary nodules: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-10585563.creator: Jianxiang Zhang, Kaihao Xu, Kepu Du, Xinwei Han, Dechao Jiao
pmc-10585563.description: BackgroundThe conventional diagnosis and treatment for highly suspected malignant pulmonary nodules (PNs) can avoid unnecessary treatment to some extent. However, the relatively separate puncture processes may not only increase puncture-related complications, but also increase the patient’s radiation exposure and hospitalization costs.

pmc-11640050.title: Novel mTORC2/HSPB4 Interaction: Role and Regulation of HSPB4 T148 Phosphorylation
pmc-11640050.creator: Zachary B Sluzala, Yang Shan, Lynda Elghazi, Emilio L Cárdenas, Angelina Hamati, Amanda L Garner, Patrice E Fort, Ram Prasad, Yvonne Adu-Rutledge
pmc-11640050.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). HSPB4 and HSPB5 (α-crystallins) have shown increasing promise as neuroprotective agents, demonstrating several anti-apoptotic and protective roles in disorders such as multiple sclerosis and diabetic retinopathy. HSPs are highly regulated by post-translational modification, including deamidation, glycosylation, and phosphorylation. Among them, T148 phosphorylation has been shown to regulate the structural and functional characteristics of HSPB4 and underlie, in part, its neuroprotective capacity.

pmc-11657072.title: Unilateral Magnetic Resonance–Guided Focused Ultrasound Lesion of the Subthalamic Nucleus in Parkinson's Disease: A Prospective Study
pmc-11657072.creator: Laura Armengou‐Garcia, Carlos A Sanchez‐Catasus, Iciar Aviles‐Olmos, Adolfo Jiménez‐Huete, Genoveva Montoya‐Murillo, Arantza Gorospe, Antonio Martin‐Bastida, Lain Hermes Gonzalez‐Quarante, Jorge Guridi, Maria C Rodriguez‐Oroz
pmc-11657072.description: BackgroundUnilateral subthalamic nucleus (STN) ablation using magnetic resonance–guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) is being explored as a new treatment for asymmetric Parkinson's disease (PD).ObjectivesThe aims were to study the efficacy and safety of this treatment in asymmetric PD patients and to characterize the lesions.

pmc-11728684.title: Exploring the Venom Gland Transcriptome of Bothrops asper and Bothrops jararaca: De Novo Assembly and Analysis of Novel Toxic Proteins
pmc-11728684.creator: Joseph Espín-Angulo, Doris Vela
pmc-11728684.description: Previous proteomic studies of viperid venom revealed that it is mainly composed of metalloproteinases (SVMPs), serine proteinases (SVSPs), phospholipase A2 (PLA2), and C-type lectins (CTLs). However, other proteins appear in minor amounts that affect prey and need to be identified.

pmc-12534419.title: Eco-friendly bricks and tuff tiles from agricultural and industrial waste: advancing the United Nations (UN) sustainable development goals
pmc-12534419.creator: Khawaja Adeel Tariq, Amina Salhi, Aashir Waleed, Muhammad Zahid, Muhammad Shahid
pmc-12534419.description: The construction industry in Pakistan faces significant challenges, including high material costs, environmental degradation, and inefficient waste management. This study addresses these issues by developing eco-friendly bricks and tuff tiles incorporating various agricultural byproducts and industrial wastes in different proportions.

pmc-12741422.title: Graves’ disease with autoimmune hepatitis and primary Sclerosing cholangitis: an overlap syndrome
pmc-12741422.creator: L K Pragathi, Dhruv Gandhi, Shivangi Tetarbe, Sudha Rao Chandrashekhar, Ira Shah
pmc-12741422.description: Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) is a chronic inflammatory disease that results from autoantibody mediated hepatocyte injury. Given its immune-mediated mechanism, it is more likely to present with other autoimmune conditions, particularly involving thyroid gland. In patients presenting with both Graves’ disease and hepatitis, the diagnostic challenge is to determine the cause of elevated liver enzymes.

pmc-13247022.title: Difference in outcomes between right and left posterior descending artery percutaneous coronary intervention: an Australian statewide registry analysis
pmc-13247022.creator: Muhtasim Rahman Zahin, Riley Batchelor, Angela Brennan, Diem Dinh, Christopher Reid, Dion Stub, Jeffrey Lefkovits
pmc-13247022.description: IntroductionPercutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is an important treatment for coronary artery disease, and coronary dominance may influence procedural risk. PCI to a left-sided posterior descending artery (L-PDA) occurs in the setting of left-dominant coronary anatomy and may involve greater anatomical complexity and a larger myocardial territory at risk than PCI to a right-sided PDA (R-PDA).

pmc-13250057.title: Enhanced anaerobic degradation and modeling of raw and treated municipal solid waste
pmc-13250057.creator: Yaser Saleem Siddiqui, Asif Ali Siddiqui, Sohail Ayub, Fazlollah Changani, Mohammad Hadi Dehghani
pmc-13250057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Conventional landfills suffer from slow waste stabilization, resulting in delayed methane recovery and persistent environmental pollution. This study addresses this challenge by investigating the comparative biogas generation potential and stabilization kinetics of raw and treated municipal solid waste (MSW) under anaerobic degradation in lab scale sealed bioreactors over a 300-day period, while integrating predictive modeling of biogas and chemical oxygen demand (COD) dynamics as an innovative analytical approach.

pmc-13255371.title: “Chill packs” self-administered olanzapine as psychiatric harm reduction for methamphetamine-induced psychosis: a narrative review of the existing evidence base
pmc-13255371.creator: Isabelle Ruedisueli, Carla Marienfeld, Casey Tiefenthaler, Allison Lee, Alicia Harvey-Vera, Steffanie Strathdee, Joseph R. Friedman
pmc-13255371.description: The prevalence of methamphetamine use disorder has risen across the United States and many other countries, which has led to a concomitant rise in methamphetamine-induced psychosis (MIP). A promising and novel approach to address MIP can be found in ‘chill packs’, a psychiatric harm reduction intervention for people using methamphetamine.

pmc-13417281.title: Polymer-Based p‑Type Exciplex Systems for Air-Stable and Processable Organic Persistent Luminescence
pmc-13417281.creator: Feilong Liu, Liyi Li, Angelo Homayoun All, Jonathan W.C. Wong, Jean-Claude G. Bünzli
pmc-13417281.description: We report the first p-type polymer-based multicomponent exciplex system exhibiting persistent luminescence (PersL). Using poly­(N-vinylcarbazole) as the polymer donor host, with 2,4,6-tris(4-methoxyphenyl)­pyrylium tetrafluoroborate and N,N′-Bis(1-naphthalenyl)-N,N′-bis-phenyl-(1,1′-biphenyl)-4,4′-diamine as the acceptor and trap material, respectively, this system achieves an afterglow lasting over 3 h.

pmc-13440186.title: Perinatal trajectories of help-seeking stigma and correlates: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13440186.creator: Tan Wang, Ying Wang, Jian Peng, Xiaoxv Yin, Qin Yan, Zina Fan, Lei Qiu, Yanhong Gong
pmc-13440186.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHelp-seeking stigma (stigma of seeking professional psychological help) is a major barrier to perinatal mental health service use. However, longitudinal evidence on heterogeneous stigma trajectories and their baseline correlates remains limited.MethodsPregnant women were recruited in the second trimester from four hospitals in two Chinese cities and completed stigma assessments at four time points (second trimester, third trimester, 1 month postpartum, and 3 months postpartum). Latent growth curve modelling assessed mean change and inter-individual variability. Growth mixture modelling identified latent trajectory classes.

pmc-13543892.title: Working memory demands modulate memory brain state engagement
pmc-13543892.creator: DT Nguyen, Nicole M Long
pmc-13543892.description: SummaryThe extent to which attention and memory processes rely on shared, as opposed to distinct, mechanisms is critical for understanding the role of both processes in cognition. We hypothesize that memory brain states, whole-brain activity patterns that support long-term memory encoding and retrieval, map onto the external/internal axis of attention.

pmc-13571431.title: Protocol to quantify LRRK2-mediated Rab10 phosphorylation using high-content imaging
pmc-13571431.creator: Beatrice Masotti, Paolo Lorenzon, Giuseppina Covello, Elisa Greggio
pmc-13571431.description: SummaryRab10 phosphorylation at Thr73 (pRab10) is a well-established readout of the kinase LRRK2, a protein whose mutations are associated with Parkinson’s disease. Here, we present a protocol for high-content quantification of endogenous pRab10-positive vesicles in primary astrocyte-enriched cultures using the Operetta CLS system. We describe steps for cell culture, immunofluorescence, image acquisition, and quantitative analysis using Harmony software.

pmc-13601473.title: Combating Alzheimer’s through sleep and exercise (CASE): A study protocol
pmc-13601473.creator: Debbie Chung, Brittany A Larsen, Laurent G Garchitorena Gomez, Alberto R Ramos, Neva J Kirk-Sanchez, Girardin Jean-Louis, Azizi A Seixas
pmc-13601473.description: Dementia affects over 55 million people worldwide, with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) comprising most cases. Because curative therapies remain unavailable, there is an urgent need for prevention strategies that target modifiable risk factors. Behavioral interventions—particularly sleep improvement and physical activity—can independently benefit cognition, brain function, and cardiometabolic health, yet their combined (potentially synergistic) effects and scalable delivery models remain underexplored.
